notes.title: New Faces Update
notes.content:
There are new faces to meet on the road. Will you encounter them all?

Introducing:
A mysterious stranger
A new caravaneer
A grumpy neighbor
A community organizer
And someone fighting to save their town

Signs of the Sojourner is also on sale in celebration of launching on PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch! Now is the perfect time to grab the game or dive back in for a replay!

tags.feature: And someone fighting to save their town

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
This update addresses a lot of the feedback we've been receiving, especially from folks on Discord. We wanted to get out an update with smaller/easier fixes ASAP, as larger features and changes will take some time.
* Balance tuning to make things a little less difficult
* Added another encounter for Nadine during the second trip
* Increased dog time <- really the most important
* Improved some text for mismatches
* Fixed various text, calendar, and other bugs
